28	    private static final Map<String, String> CITY_REGION = Map.of(

39	     * @return the canonical region for {@code city}, or {@code "UNKNOWN"} when the
40	     *         city is not in the fixed table.

42	    public static String of(String city) {
43	        return CITY_REGION.getOrDefault(city, UNKNOWN);

components:

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.

          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

  owner_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,

  description VARCHAR(255),

) engine=InnoDB;

  password VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL ,

- `InvalidOwnerPostcodeException` + `InvalidOwnerPostcodeExceptionHandler` (returns `{"errors":["postcode"]}`, 400) + escalation YAML — following the existing telephone/email pattern.

- `postcode` column added to all four schema dialects; positional seed inserts in `hsqldb`/`mysql` `data.sql` updated with a `NULL` postcode (h2/postgres already use explicit column lists).

One judgment call: I applied the same validation to the `PUT /owners/{ownerId}` path (not just `POST`) so the field behaves consistently across both write endpoints, since both bind `OwnerFieldsDto`. The tests only exercise `POST`, but this keeps the contract coherent.
